text:
Ava: quick follow-up on pricing Q&A 11: dropping a single thread for clarifications about credits, rate limits, and demo spikes. post short customer snippets and we'll answer.
Rohit: customer snippet: 'we launched a promo and hit a spike1 our dashboard showed huge token burn. how do we prevent this in future demos?'
Nina: short: make sure you estimate streaming tokens and tool-call outputs. also use temporary rate caps for demo keys and restrict to specific routes.
Diego: demo keys? how do we set those?
Nina: Support can issue time-limited demo keys tied to a low-per-second quota and a total credit allowance. request needs demo date, expected concurrent users, and example prompts.
Kenji: ops note: when a route exceeds quota we return 429 + Retry-After by default. we also log a `quota_violation` event for visibility. Dedicated customers can enable a short queue (configurable 3-10s) or fallback to lower-cost models during overflow.
Rohit: is there any soft-grace for unexpected launches?
Nina: yes, small automatic gracebursts exist for accounts in good standing but they consume credits and are rate-limited. larger temporary increases require a support request.
Ava: what about mid-cycle top-ups and proration?
Nina: one-off top-ups prorate into the remaining billing period. monthly recurring credits apply at cycle start. enterprise committed credits follow contract terms.
Diego: customer asked why streaming seems to bill more than the visible transcript. are hidden tokens counted?
Kenji: billing counts prompt tokens, response tokens (including partial streamed tokens), and any tool outputs. theres small per-request metadata overhead that can be noticeable with many tiny responses. batching reduces that overhead.
Rohit: SDK/backoff behavior on 429s?
Kenji: SDKs return Retry-After plus `x-rw-quota-token`. they emit a `rate_limit.hit` event. we'll ship a client helper for jittered exponential backoff in the next SDK release. for now recommend token-bucket friendly retry with capped retries.
Ava: Console improvements: product will add a "credits remaining" overlay and per-route usage breakdown in the next UI sprint; also alerts at 70/90/100%.
billing-bot: alert: workspace ACME-demo at 82% credits used.
Nina: action items: (1) Support template for demo key requests, (2) KB with streaming cost examples + calc widget, (3) engineering to add SDK backoff helper note to sprint.
Ava: thanks all. drop any follow-ups here and we'll fold into the KB.
